whatItIs: artiq is an open-source project in the pulse and control category. It is maintained by m-labs and primarily looks like a Python codebase. Repository moved to https://git.m-labs.hk/M-Labs/artiq
For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches pulse and control workflows in practice.
whoItsFor: Hardware-adjacent developers and researchers working closer to experiments, pulse schedules, or lab orchestration.
whatYouCanBuild: See how low-level control stacks differ from higher-level SDKs.
